user.title: Configure Surplus Power
user.description: Select the net grid balance, charger, and protected-load entities. Only the charger input switch will ever be controlled.

data_description.surplus_power_entity: Select the site's net grid balance, not raw solar production. It must be positive when exporting to the grid and negative when importing from it.
data_description.charger_switch_entity: The switch supplying AC charging input to the battery. This is the integration's only controlled entity.
data_description.charger_power_entity: Instantaneous power drawn through the battery's charging input.
data_description.charger_energy_entity: Cumulative energy delivered through the battery's charging input, reported in Wh or kWh.
data_description.load_power_entity: Instantaneous power consumed by the protected load. This entity is read only.
data_description.load_energy_entity: Cumulative energy consumed by the protected load, reported in Wh or kWh. This entity is read only.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure source entities
reconfigure.description: Review or change the net grid balance, charger, and protected-load entities. Only the charger input switch will ever be controlled.

data_description.surplus_power_entity: Select the site's net grid balance, not raw solar production. It must be positive when exporting to the grid and negative when importing from it.
data_description.charger_switch_entity: The switch supplying AC charging input to the battery. This is the integration's only controlled entity.
data_description.charger_power_entity: Instantaneous power drawn through the battery's charging input.
data_description.charger_energy_entity: Cumulative energy delivered through the battery's charging input, reported in Wh or kWh.
data_description.load_power_entity: Instantaneous power consumed by the protected load. This entity is read only.
data_description.load_energy_entity: Cumulative energy consumed by the protected load, reported in Wh or kWh. This entity is read only.

data_description.minimum_probe_surplus_w: Minimum positive net grid export required before the startup timer begins.
data_description.load_outage_duration_s: How long both protected-load meters must be unavailable before the battery is treated as empty.
data_description.load_recovery_duration_s: How long both protected-load meters must remain available before reserve recovery may finish.
data_description.recovery_target_percent: Reserve charged after a confirmed empty-battery outage, even without surplus.
